## Official Release / 官方发布

**Kitloader {{VERSION}}** is an official release for **Paper/Folia 1.21.11** and **Java 21**.

Kitloader is fully open source. It contains no backdoor, telemetry, or server-data collection. Data created by the plugin remains on your server. Download only from [Lazyzouo/Kitloader Releases](https://github.com/Lazyzouo/Kitloader/releases).

**Kitloader {{VERSION}}** 是适用于 **Paper/Folia 1.21.11** 与 **Java 21** 的官方发布。

Kitloader 彻底开源，不含后门、遥测或服务器数据收集机制。插件创建的数据只保存在你的服务器上。请只从 [Lazyzouo/Kitloader Releases](https://github.com/Lazyzouo/Kitloader/releases) 下载。

### Downloads / 下载

- `en.us.jar`: English default package
- `zh.cn.jar`: Simplified Chinese default package

GitHub-generated source snapshots are source only, not installation packages. See [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Lazyzouo/Kitloader/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for release details.

GitHub 自动生成的源码快照仅供查看源码，不是安装包。发布详情请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Lazyzouo/Kitloader/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。
